Vendored from https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC (Apache-2.0) at commit fae2a0a.
Kept: library sources (src/), cmake/, and the bundled marisa, rapidjson, darts-clone and tclap dependencies.
Left out: tests, docs, data build pipeline, Python/Node bindings, plugins.
MCnotepad ships plain-text dictionaries in resources/opencc/ and loads them with its own s2t.json / t2s.json.
